Subjects.Subject: Invitation to participate in the 2026 SES Respondent Engagement Survey

BodyHtmls.BodyHtml:
Dear ^first_name^,

We apologise for the error in the previous email, where the subject line incorrectly referred to GOS instead of SES. 

Thank you for your recent participation in the 2026 Student Experience Survey (SES) collection.

We would like to invite ^E306CTXT^ to participate in the Quality Indicators for Learning and Teaching (QILT) Respondent Engagement Survey (RES) for the 2026 SES.

This survey will help us better understand how institutions are engaging their students and how we can improve the survey engagement materials we provide to institutions.

We welcome feedback from all institutions participating in the 2026 SES, regardless of whether they conducted any survey engagement or promotional activities this year.

The survey link below is unique to ^E306CTXT^, so we ask that you collate your answers internally and only complete the survey once. The survey will close on Friday 30 October. 

To begin the survey, please click the button below. 

Take the survey

 

The results from the RES will be summarised and published on the QILT Provider Portal. 

Thank you for being a part of the QILT initiative.

Kind regards,

The QILT Team


The Social Research Centre
Phone: +61 3 9114 1003 (QILT line)
www.srcentre.com.au

 

To unsubscribe click here

Note.Text:
ABOUT THIS JOB
=========================================================================================
This job was copied from  GOS-L RES (and prev from SES RES) job so need to make sure that all skips/updates are related to GOS.

GOS RES 3199RES - had more variable copied over this time over from SRC_Shell including cati variables which were blank of course.

=========================================================================================
TODO - update scripting to refer to 2026 and GOS  in the script called "To set hidden variables" 

TODO updated line below once we get final word doc
The following question that are hidden for GOS-L and GOS  ( since they are used in SES only)
CALT2, CALT3, CALT4, CALT5 and CALT6
=========================================================================================

Sample variables can be found in Callblock/startblock/Background -

=========================================================================================
DELETED QUESTION in 3199RES
GOS RES - question deleted were TOOLS, CQR, CALT and CALT1.
=========================================================================================

THIS WAS A ONE OFF - NO LONGER NEEDED SINCE THE LATEST IS NOW English(Australia)
Also when copied over we changed the language from English to English(Australia) - so selected managed translations and exported English text updated the excel fiel then imported it into English(Australia)

=====================================
The SAVE and CLOSE button was added in for 3199RES - copeid from src_shell but have to be modified for Qilt.since not compatible.
=====================================

GENERAL HOW TO DO STUFF IN FORSTA below

===============================================================================
HOW TO UPLOAD AN IMAGE ( eg CALT for this job) 
To upload a pdf file for question CALT select File  manager and then go to the folder and upload the picture .
Then click on the 3 dots and copy url and goto the question CALT and click on the lock ie ( paper clip look) and past in the URL. 
Similar concept to logo but the url link is in the look and feel button on the left side of Design,
===============================================================================

===============================================================================
HOW TO SET UP DUMMY SAMPLE VARIABLES FOR INPUT DURING TESTING MODE
To input data some sample variables for testing purpose you need  to add it to the "Update Background for testing" which is found right at the top in non-production (no-live) mode condition
===============================================================================

===============================================================================
HOW TO PUT TEXT IN FOR A CLOSED JOB (similar to projinactive.htm)
Goto confirmit - select job
select Survey Management
underneath on the right select Survey MEssages
Search for closed (since it's a long list of message to find)
Past the text in both boxes "Survey closed" page title" and ""Survey closed" page text."
===============================================================================
TO UPDATED FOOTER
GOTO CONFIRMIT - SELECT SURVEY DESIGNER
Goto Home, Survey designer, select layout scroll dow to - Select MAin Theme until you get the htmls text on the right side and at the bottom you should see the footer.
you may need to right click to say edit in profressional mode on the Main theme when selected.

FormText.Text:
Thank you for being involved in the Quality Indicators for Learning and Teaching (QILT) initiative.

To help us continue to improve the services provided to ^f('E306CTXT')^, we invite you to participate in our QILT Respondent Engagement Survey for the ^f('YEAR')^ ^f('QILTJOBC')^ (^f('QILTJOB')^). The information collected will be used to better understand engagement activities that your institution undertakes and improve the supporting materials that we provide.

This survey should take approximately 5 minutes and can be completed any time up until Friday 30 October.

Please note that there are no right or wrong answers — we are simply interested in learning about your experience. Just answer as best you can, even if you are unsure.

If you need to take a break, you can just close your browser. You can come back to the survey at any time and continue from where you stopped.

If you would like to go back to a previous question, please use the ‘Previous’ button within the survey. Please do not use the browser ‘Back’ button to go back to a previous question.

This is a unique survey link for your institution, and it has been sent to all QILT contacts at ^f('E306CTXT')^. Please collate feedback centrally to complete the survey. Note this survey is focused on the ^f('YEAR')^ ^f('QILTJOB')^.
